title: Acoustic Resonance
description: A bar rings at the frequencies whose half-waves fit its length exactly, f = n·v/2L. Drive it at one of them and the vibration builds on itself until the bar shakes apart along its weakest planes: in an ore, the grain boundaries between the metal and the rock. Unlocks the Resonance Chamber: more metal from raw ore, and tuned crystal shards.

puzzle.goal: A bar of length L in which sound travels at speed v rings in standing waves with nodes at both ends. Write the frequency f of its n-th mode.
puzzle.name: Standing waves in a bar
puzzle.ask: Find f in hertz for mode n = @{n} of a bar L = @{L} m long, v = @{v} m/s.

vars.v: speed of sound in the bar

puzzle.method: A whole number of half-wavelengths must fit: L = n·λ/2, and f = v/λ.
